messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Observability gap detected for tenant=NovaCorp (dedicated-pool-33). Spans/traces absent in tracing service for requests that succeeded at infra layer. Trigger: tenant-trace-missing alert at p95. Pager: alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): ack — I'm on it, grabbing context. Is this affecting request surface or just traces/logs?

ben (sre): right now only traces/spans are missing. Metrics and logs partially present but traces that link to request-ids from NovaCorp are not showing up in ES/traces store. No big increase in error rate reported by infra.

carla (eng-plat): adding what we know: NovaCorp uses VPC forwarder (forwarder-vpc-33) + dedicated kafka bridge. Forwarder pods rotated ~03:02 UTC and one had an RBAC token refresh failure. Might be related.

alice (oncall): can someone confirm forwarder pod restart timeline vs missing trace window?

ben (sre): checking k8s events now. here's the quick log: 
```
kubectl -n observability get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=forwarder-vpc-33
2026-03-15T03:01:55Z forwarder-vpc-33 OOMKilled
2026-03-15T03:02:10Z forwarder-vpc-33 TokenRefreshFailed: serviceaccount token invalid
2026-03-15T03:02:20Z forwarder-vpc-33 CrashLoopBackOff
```
Looks like token refresh failed and pod rotated to a new service account token which didn't have the tenant-forwarder role bound due to a race in our automation.

dinesh (support): NovaCorp reported "missing traces in APM" at 03:07 UTC in their ticket. They didn't report errors, just inability to link traces for certain request-ids while logs show processing.

carla (eng-plat): OK — hypothesis: forwarder lost ability to write to internal-trace-ingest because the forwarded identity lacked cross-tenant write permission for that dedicated pool. That would drop spans even though logs/kafka ingress: works.

alice (oncall): customer impact? Are any SLAs breached?

ben (sre): SLA wise request latency/availability is fine. It's an observability loss (reads), severity = P2 customer-facing but not user-visible failures. Still urgent for NovaCorp support.

carla (eng-plat): mitigation options (short-term):
1) Rebind ephemeral role to the restarted forwarder pod (ephemeral role fix)
2) Temporarily enable cross-tenant-read fallback on a worker to reconstruct traces from logs (read-only)
3) If we can get the missing spans, run a trace-replay ingestion job from archived logs for the 03:00–03:10 window.

alice (oncall): plan: (A) rebind role and restart forwarder; (B) if traces still absent, run replay job. Ben — can you rebind and roll now? Carla — if we need replay, who owns the replay script?

ben (sre): I can do the rebind + restart. I'll also tail the ingest logs. Command I'll run: 
```
# rebind ephemeral role to serviceaccount
kubectl -n observability create rolebinding forwarder-obs-temp --clusterrole=tenant-forwarder --serviceaccount=observability:forwarder-vpc-33
kubectl -n observability rollout restart deployment/forwarder-vpc-33
```
Expect 30-60s to stabilize.

carla (eng-plat): replay script lives in infra/tools/trace-replay. I'll stand by to run with parameters if needed. Example: 
```
./trace-replay --tenant novacorp --from 2026-03-15T03:00:00Z --to 2026-03-15T03:12:00Z --output=ingest
```

ops-bot: action started by ben (sre): rolebinding/create forwarder-obs-temp, rollout restart deployment/forwarder-vpc-33.

ben (sre): rolebinding applied, restarting now. tailing ingest logs: 
```
kubectl -n observability logs -f deployment/ingest-processor | grep novacorp
```

ben (sre): forwarder pod is back up and now authenticating. I see writes to trace-ingest for tenant=novacorp at 03:04:10Z.

alice (oncall): are traces visible in the UI yet?

ben (sre): partial. new traces after 03:04 are ingested, but events in the 03:00–03:04 window still missing. We should run replay.

carla (eng-plat): starting replay prep. Replayer needs a short maintenance window because it will write back into trace-store for that tenant only. I'll spin it in safe mode (dedicated namespace, dry-run first).

dinesh (support): I notified NovaCorp: "We've identified an observability ingestion gap tied to a forwarder rotation. We are applying a fix and replaying discarded spans for the 03:00–03:12 window. Will update in ~20m." Customer replied :thumbsup:.

carla (eng-plat): executing dry-run first to validate mapping of request-ids -> spans. Command: 
```
./trace-replay --tenant novacorp --from 2026-03-15T03:00:00Z --to 2026-03-15T03:12:00Z --dry-run
```

carla (eng-plat): dry-run verified. launching replay (safe mode, rate-limited) now.

ops-bot: trace-replay job queued: trace-replay-novacorp-2120001111-1. Estimated run-time 6m.

ben (sre): monitoring ingest logs for backfilled entries. I'm seeing spans being written with original timestamps. Confirming linkability to existing traces.

alice (oncall): can SRE/plat confirm no duplication risk?

carla (eng-plat): replayed spans include idempotency checks (we check span id and timestamp). Duplicate spans are dropped by ingest pipeline if identical. Safe.

ben (sre): replay finished successfully. Ingest logs show ~1.2k spans re-ingested for NovaCorp between 03:00–03:12.

dinesh (support): updating customer: "We completed ingestion backfill for the missing window. You should now see traces for the request-ids you reported. Please confirm and re-open if anything missing"

alice (oncall): monitoring UI — traces for previously missing request-ids now present. Good. Rebound rolebinding is still in place, but we should remove ephemeral binding and deploy fix to automation to prevent recurrence.

carla (eng-plat): opened PR to automation (fix: ensure rolebinding created before forwarder rotation completes; fallback to new-serviceaccount detection) — PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3345.

ben (sre): cleanup: removing temporary rolebinding now. 
```
kubectl -n observability delete rolebinding forwarder-obs-temp || true
```

alice (oncall): final check-in: no SLA breach. NovaCorp confirms traces visible. Incident classified as "observability ingestion gap due to ephemeral RBAC race". Action items:
- carla: merge automation fix PR (ETA 2d)
- eng-sre: add post-incident test to rotate forwarder in staging to validate binding (ETA 3d)
- support/dinesh: follow up with NovaCorp summary + RCA (ETA 1d)

incident-bot: Incident resolved for thread 2120001111. Logged as: OBS-2026-03-15-014. Severity: P2. Actions recorded, follow-ups assigned.

alice (oncall): thanks team — closing thread. If anything resurfaces, reopen."
